indicator_definition: Total GHG emissions from the energy sector in million tonnes of CO₂ equivalent. Covers combustion in power plants, refineries and other energy industries. Reported under UNFCCC and compiled by Eurostat.
rationale: The energy sector is the largest source of GHG emissions. Decarbonising energy production is essential for meeting climate targets. Progress means a sustained reduction in energy sector emissions.
methodology_characteristics: Reported by national authorities under UNFCCC using IPCC methodology. Covers CRF sector 1A (fuel combustion) and 1B (fugitive emissions). Published annually.
